scope: Three existing collection drill scenarios strengthened for actual mounted-App browser Back/Forward and direct collection roots; not a rerun of the full63 portfolio matrix.

regression.observation: All three immutable deployed-build states had the correct collection hash and zero pending API requests in the same document, but the selected relationship remained visible and the portfolio was absent.

gap: The prior collection scenarios clicked Back to vendor register and then manually reselected the collection. That explicit action cleared selected state and bypassed the actual browser-history route lifecycle. Their returned:true Boolean did not establish browser Back correctness.
fix: The active scenarios now assert real history Back in the original document before any helper reload or explicit return. Reads must settle; the expected populated collection and selected tab/panel must be visible, and selected relationship detail must be absent. Forward, direct hash root, cold root reload and in-app Register return have distinct receipts.
limitations: Corrected runtime and evidence scripts are bound by file hashes while publication is pending.
Full reload checks wait for the rendered loaded collection; API counters are intentionally absent in the newly created document.
Local evidence uses the real App route lifecycle with synthetic reads; it does not establish live backend authorization.
Hosted customer before/after verification and release gates are owned by root.
Reviewed PR584 evidence remains unchanged; this receipt adds the previously missing history transition coverage.
